result.quote: So the man of God went another way and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
result.reason: Verse 13:10 directly supports the keyed action. However, the window does not identify the person addressed in verses 13:8–9 as the king, so “with the king” requires missing context. Revise to “What did the man of God do after speaking?” The edit otherwise preserves the original intended fact and answer scope.
